speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
text: asked	the Minister for Health whether the Ministry will be coming up with guidelines on the appropriate pre- and post-counselling and confidentiality and protection statements for the utilisation of personalised medicine.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: PHMCA stipulates requirements on the protection of medical records, including the confidentiality and integrity of the records.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: HBRA provides a consent framework for the conduct of human biomedical research, including requirements relating to appropriate consent-taking from research subjects.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Given that the field is evolving rapidly, there is a need to keep abreast of developments and review our safeguards so as to ensure patient and public interests.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The need for informed consent, security and confidentiality of information and disclosure of test results to third parties outside direct healthcare providers will also be addressed.

speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Dr Lam Pin Min) (for the Minister for Health)
text: MOH will consult relevant stakeholders on the draft standards when they are ready.

speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
text: MOH's inspection and audit teams will also check that these tests were ordered by qualified medical personnel and counselling was conducted appropriately.
